summary: No structural or behavioral parity defects. All 3 scenarios and every control are present in the WinUI 3 UIA tree, and scenario-1 enabled/disabled states match the live UWP golden exactly. The only migration friction was a build-time CS0579 duplicate assembly-attribute error from the copied legacy AssemblyInfo.cs (fixed with GenerateAssemblyInfo=false), which did not affect final parity.
